reporter._comment: first_name/last_name are split from full_name if left blank. The fly-tipping form asks for YOUR home address: put your postcode in address_postcode, and enough of the first line in address_line (e.g. '12 Example Road') for the tool to pick it from the results.

keys._comment_mapbox: A Mapbox PUBLIC token (starts pk.) for the interactive web maps. Never a secret sk. token - it ends up inside the exported HTML files. Make it at account.mapbox.com/access-tokens with only the styles:read, styles:tiles and fonts:read scopes, and add a URL restriction if you host the maps anywhere.

highways_login._comment: Signs you in to highways.northnorthants.gov.uk so reports attach to your account. Run move-keys-out.bat to move this password out of a synced folder.

routing._comment: Fly-tipping always goes to forms.northnorthants.gov.uk/service/Report_fly_tipping. This is not a setting: the highways site lists a Flytipping category but refuses the report, showing a notice pointing at that form instead. See nncr/routing.py.

submission._comment: confirm = prefill everything and stop at the final Submit button for you to click. Never fully automatic.

map._comment: Corby town centre. Only used before any pins are on the map - once you have reports the view fits around them.

mymap._comment: Optional. The id of your Google My Map (the mid= part of its link). Leave blank to hide the My Map buttons.

bins._comment: How close a park has to be for the bins form's 'is it in a park?' question to be answered yes. A bin on the pavement outside a park is not in it.
